hero.heading: Powering Human Freedom, One Task at a Time
hero.tagline: At BitTasker, we believe in the power of decentralized work. By enabling anyone, anywhere, to earn through their skills, we help unlock human potential and financial freedom—one task at a time.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: BitTasker exists to empower everyday people to earn, trade, and thrive without borders, banks, or barriers. We are building a platform where skills become currency, and Bitcoin becomes the bridge between sovereign individuals.

core_beliefs.title: Our Core Beliefs
core_beliefs.description: At BitTasker, we believe in economic freedom, digital dignity, and the power of peer-to-peer collaboration to transform lives around the globe.
core_beliefs.bitcoin_text: We embrace Bitcoin as the tool to unlock global earning potential for the unbanked, underpaid, and overregulated.
core_beliefs.tasks_text: Every person has value. BitTasker connects hands-on skills with global demand—no resumé, no gatekeepers, just proof of value.
core_beliefs.decentralization_text: Legacy platforms extract value through censorship and excessive fees. We choose a better path: peer-to-peer, open, and fair.
core_beliefs.sovereignty_text: We help people own their time, money, and future by enabling direct, censorship-resistant earning.

platform.title: Our Platform
platform.description: BitTasker is not just a company—it's a mission to decentralize income and make Bitcoin useful in everyday life.

escrow.title: Secure Payment Contracts & Reputation
escrow.description: The hirer locks the payment until they approve the work and pay the invoice.

fiat.title: Fiat On-Ramp
fiat.description: Buy bitcoin with a card or bank transfer. The coins are paid to your own address.

platform.alert: We’re building a platform where freedom, fairness, and financial inclusion thrive—powered by Bitcoin and community trust.
